pressure_scope: Existing pressure_error_psi field is only the true75psi midpoint, where symmetric excitation/return drop cancels. Added pressure_error_by_true_psi evaluates0/75/150psi on each powered case; these are finite transfer points, not sensor accuracy guarantees.

retained_case_mapping.one_main_return: Current normal primary-return architecture; installed bonds must match.
retained_case_mapping.two_main_returns: Historical/prohibited common-load current sharing; no current redundancy credit.
retained_case_mapping.both_returns_lost_*: CurrentF1.1 primary-return-open faults; names retained only to identify historical numerical cases.

remaining: 6.1/6.2W are finite steady constant-power budgets, not a current-limit/startup/load-dump silicon model.6.2W is an additional analysis allocation.
The15mA sensor current is a hot sensitivity allocation, not a manufacturer guaranteed maximum.
20mA antenna remote current and13kOhm powered CAN input assumptions are retained. Unknown off-state/negative-bus die clamps remain unbounded.
No-equilibrium result is not safe shutdown proof. Powered-model CAN injection is not universal vehicle non-interference.
F1.1 wire/contact/fuse thermal and installed endpoint acceptance remain; no load splitting or redundant-return survival is claimed.
